title: After the Hakodate Kinen: A Night View Like None Other ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Putting the momentum she's gained from sightseeing to use, Mejiro Palmer runs well in the Hakodate Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, it seems that she still doesn't know what she truly wants to do. In order to find out…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides to revisit Hokkaido in the summer and think about it while having some fun. We set her next goal as next year's Nikkei Shinshun Hai.
